notes: Top status bar reorganized: the master limiter is centred under a MASTER label, the computer volume is separated and relabelled SYS VOL, and the controls are one consistent size.
More DJ library imports: Serato, VirtualDJ, Mixxx and Engine DJ join Rekordbox and Traktor — tracks, hot cues, beat grids, key and playlists/crates.
Set the downbeat: place bar "one" exactly on the grid and waveform, with smarter downbeat handling.
Jog or seek on one deck no longer disturbs the other playing deck.
Each deck shows its live BPM, with a highlight when the two decks are matched.
Folded "butterfly" waveform and DJ mixer layout polish.
Closing the window can no longer freeze the app on exit.
Clearer load errors, transport stays disabled until a track is loaded, and hot cues are auto-placed on load.
SYNC is no longer silently starved when a track's BPM is missing from the catalog.
New vintage scalloped knob themes for the Retro Sci-Fi look.
